note: Plain customer queries and the item each one must find among the first three results of the lexical search over identity and purpose, which is what the hosted search reads. The author of the purposes wrote the first group. An adversarial reviewer wrote the second group after the purposes existed, using different words on purpose. Five of the ten reviewer queries missed on the first run and two of them returned nothing at all; the purposes were widened with the customer's words and the queries were left unchanged. Three author queries also regressed while the purposes were being widened, because one added word was shared by several purposes, and the wording was separated again. This is a smoke check over 24 items, not a relevance benchmark and not evidence that any item helped a task.
